Tones: success = Active/Published/Confirmed/Completed/Paid/Settled/Done/Won/Verified; warning = Draft/In progress/Pending/Upcoming/Part paid/Quoted/On hold; danger = Expired/Blocked/Overdue/Cancelled/Lost/Failed/Missing; info = Open/New/On trip/To collect/Due/Sent/Lead/Scheduled/Invited; neutral = Inactive/Archived/Refunded/Void/Deactivated. warning also covers invoice Partially paid; danger covers member Suspended. Document readiness roll-ups use domain="document" (ready, action-needed, expiring-soon, expired, missing); ledger entries use domain="ledger" (credit = payment received → success, debit → info, refund → warning, adjustment → neutral). Team members use domain="member" (active success, invited info, deactivated neutral, suspended danger).
Use: Status column in any DataTable
Avoid: Never pick a status colour by hand or pass a tone to StatusChip for a domain status → StatusBadge
